title: Fixed additive coefficient maps commute with horizontal differentials
statement: For any scheme X, finite family U of opens and injective resolution I of the additive etale structure sheaf, let A be the ordinary unit Cech complex after forgetting scalars and applying ULift, and let c_n:A^n → D^{n,0} be the product of I.ι.f 0 applied to ULift of restrictFunctorΓ.inv of each ordinary unit section coordinate. Then c_n followed by the horizontal differential D^{n,0} → D^{m,0} equals A.d n m followed by c_m, for all n,m. No affine or cover condition is required.

source.place: Theorem 59.22.4, affine acyclicity and natural coefficient sections; Tag 01EQ, Lemma 20.11.2, beta augmentation.

proof.text: The inverse restrictFunctorΓ identifies the unit-section presheaf, after forgetting scalars and lifting, with the additive structure presheaf restricted to open subschemes. Its naturality gives a natural transformation ρ; compose ρ with the restricted resolution augmentation to obtain σ. In each degree, PreservesProduct.iso identifies the lifted product of module sections with the product of their lifted additive groups. Projecting the adjacent differential to a tuple and using cechComplexFunctor_d_π, functoriality, additivity and piComparison_comp_π proves these comparisons form a complex isomorphism e. The composite e.hom followed by cechComplexFunctor.map σ has the prescribed coefficient maps as components, by cechComplexFunctor_map_f_π and product projection identities. Its complex-map equation gives the horizontal compatibility in all degrees. The unchanged vertical equation follows by evaluating I.ι_f_zero_comp_complex_d coordinatewise. The constructions and product identities also apply to the empty tuple-index family, empty or repeated opens, and degree zero.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03P2 and 01EQ, coefficient augmentation; implemented through naturality and the Cech functor.

lean.statement:
theorem additiveCechCoefficientMap_comm {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (n m : ℕ) :
    additiveCechCoefficientMap U I n ≫
        ((etaleOpenCechResolutionDoubleComplex X (additiveCechOpenInclusion X) U I).flip.X
          0).d n m =
      (additiveCechCoefficientComplex U).d n m ≫ additiveCechCoefficientMap U I m
